The '''Thaylia system''' was located in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Thaylian bog-slime]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Thaylian bog-slime]]|system=Thaylia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thaylia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
